settings.source: Selects the exact imported slideshow resolved when the run is enqueued.
settings.captionMode: Selects original, replacement or intentionally empty caption semantics.
settings.caption: Supplies exact replacement text only when captionMode is replacement.

settings.identity: Selects the saved identity resolved when the run is enqueued.
settings.referenceGroup: Includes all available, reference, before or after assets exactly as selected.
settings.optional: Allows no identity selection to produce null; it does not excuse an empty selected group.

settings.references: Selects ordered workspace image asset IDs resolved when the run is enqueued.
settings.maxItems: Rejects a selected reference list above this count without truncating it.
settings.optional: Allows an empty selected list to produce an empty reference package.

settings.mode: Selects the configured adaptation route value.
settings.textStrategy: Selects keep, rewrite or remove for on-image text.
settings.creativeBrief: Supplies the exact free-text creative direction.
settings.creativeDirectionPolicy: Selects whether written direction may propose changes or must agree with switches.

settings.value: Supplies the visible manual value only when no trigger or parent payload is present.
settings.payloadPath: Selects one exact nested field from a trigger or parent payload and never guesses another path.

settings.modelId: Selects the primary AI model for this node.
settings.userPrompt: Defines the visible task and variable placement.
settings.outputMode: Selects plain text or strict structured output.
settings.responseSchema: Defines the exact structured output contract when outputMode is structured.
settings.runWhen: Selects always-run or explicit primary-input skip behavior.
settings.systemPrompt: Defines workflow-author permanent instructions kept separate from connected data.
settings.creativity: Maps Consistent, Balanced or Exploratory to the documented provider temperature.
settings.maxAttempts: Bounds attempts made under the node failure policy.
settings.fallbackModelId: Selects the explicit model used only after the first failed attempt.
settings.failureMode: Selects stop, error output or empty-result continuation.

settings.template: Defines the exact deterministic output template rendered from connected values.

settings.maxRetries: Bounds corrected passes through the visible retry route.
settings.feedbackPath: Selects the exact corrected value inside feedback without fallback or repair.

settings.path: Selects one exact existing nested field and fails when it is missing.
Selects the exact field inspected by the condition.
settings.operator: Selects one explicit typed comparison and never evaluates code.
settings.compareValue: Supplies the exact comparison value for operators that require one.

settings.controls: Defines the only setting paths and values the interpreter may classify.
settings.briefPath: Selects the exact settings path read as creative direction.
settings.policyPath: Selects the exact settings path read as change policy.
settings.resultPath: Selects the exact empty settings path where resolution evidence will be written.
settings.minConfidence: Defines the minimum accepted model confidence and never changes a choice.
settings.maxBriefCharacters: Rejects an oversized direction without truncating it.
settings.requirementCategories: Defines the only accepted IDs for free-text requirement categories.
settings.requirementPlacements: Defines the only accepted IDs for preserve, change or avoid destinations.
settings.maxRequirements: Rejects too many classified requirements without dropping any.
settings.allowIgnoredClauses: Selects whether a fully evidenced non-actionable clause with a reason is permitted.

settings.systemInstructions: Defines the visible immutable interpretation contract for this version.
settings.taskInstructions: Defines the visible task applied to the prepared request.
settings.creativity: Maps the selected consistency mode to the documented provider temperature.
settings.modelId: Selects the primary AI model for interpretation.
settings.maxAttempts: Bounds attempts made under the node failure policy.
settings.fallbackModelId: Selects the explicit model used only after the first failed attempt.
settings.failureMode: Selects stop, error output or empty-result continuation.

settings.maxItems: Rejects a larger list and passes an allowed list unchanged.

settings.mode: Selects named-object packaging or one-level ordered list append.
settings.inputs: Defines the exact stable input socket IDs, names and required flags.

settings.subworkflowSlot: Selects the deployment binding for one pinned live child workflow.
settings.childInputs: Supplies an exact fixed runtime-input object separate from the connected child payload.
settings.failureMode: Selects stop, error output or empty-result continuation.

settings.subworkflowSlot: Selects the deployment binding for the pinned live child workflow.
settings.maxItems: Rejects an oversized list without truncating it.
settings.concurrency: Requests parallel child runs subject only to the visible workflow policy cap.
settings.itemFailure: Selects keep-successful collection or stop-on-any-failure behavior.
settings.childInputs: Supplies the same exact fixed runtime-input object to each child run.
settings.failureMode: Selects stop, error output or empty-result continuation for node-level failure.

settings.url: Defines the exact rendered public HTTP or HTTPS destination.
settings.method: Selects the exact supported HTTP method.
settings.body: Defines the exact rendered JSON body for methods that send one.
settings.credentialSlot: Selects a deployment credential binding without embedding a secret.
settings.credentialKind: Selects the exact bearer, basic or header serialization.
settings.headers: Defines exact rendered non-secret request headers.
settings.maxAttempts: Bounds safe attempts; mutating retries require an explicit idempotency key.
settings.failureMode: Selects stop or explicit error-output routing.

settings.profile: Selects the visible read-only Recreate TikTok v1 validation contract.
settings.maxSlides: Rejects an oversized plan collection without truncating it.
settings.failureMode: Selects stop or explicit repair-error routing.

settings.modelId: Selects the exact image model for the batch.
settings.ratio: Selects the exact aspect ratio, which must be compatible with every request mode.
settings.resolution: Selects the exact supported image resolution.
settings.partialFailure: Selects keep-successful output or stop without canvas output.
settings.concurrency: Requests parallel generation subject only to the visible workflow policy cap.
settings.maxAttempts: Bounds provider attempts for each image request.
settings.failureMode: Selects stop or explicit error-output routing when the node fails.

settings.includePlanNote: Selects whether an editable plan note is created beside generated images.

settings.outcome: Selects successful final output or deliberate run failure.
settings.message: Defines the exact rendered result or failure message.
